artworks.title: L'orage
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a figure leaning against a tree surrounded by a flock of sheep. Dense stylized trees obscure the horizon, blending with the vegetation. The black and white palette emphasizes contrasts with expressive lines typical of woodcuts. A dog stands close by, and another is with the shepherd. The shepherd appears deep in thought, looking at the flock grazing in an open meadow. In the distance, sheep graze as they fade into the background, creating a sense of depth in the serene setting.

artworks.title: Etude (Maurice Dumont)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person from the chest up, facing slightly to their left with a gentle head tilt. They have a beard and mustache, with a contemplative expression. The wavy hair is textured and deep, and they wear a garment with a high collar. One hand is raised near the collar or neck area. The background has rough, expressive shading, emphasizing the person's face and upper body.

artworks.title: Aimez-vous les uns les autres
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a landscape with their arms folded. They have a somber facial expression, wearing a tall hat, a long coat, and a white collar. In front of them is an open basket and unusual objects scattered around. A guillotine is in the background, with a cloudy or smoky sky.

artworks.title: Aimez-vous les uns les autres
artworks.medium: lithograph in blue-black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with their hands folded in front of them. They are wearing a long, dark robe and a tall black hat. Their facial features are serious, with a broad face, deep-set eyes, and slightly furrowed brows. In the background, there is a cloudy sky and a silhouette of a large structure resembling a guillotine. In the foreground, there is a large open basket to the right of the person, with some objects placed on the ground nearby.

artworks.title: Devant la rampe
artworks.medium: inkless embossing (gaufrage) on heavy wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The sculpture is of a nude figure with outstretched arms. It is embossed onto a piece of paper or thin material, giving it a subtle raised appearance. The color of the sculpture matches the material it is on, which is a light beige or off-white. Detailed features are difficult to discern due to the lack of contrast. The sculpture is presented flat, relying on shadows and texture created by the embossing process to be visible.

artworks.title: Etude
artworks.medium: lithograph in red on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a slightly hunched position from head to foot. Their head is tilted downward, resting on their raised left hand. The facial features are lightly sketched, with a prominent nose and closed eyes. The person has short, straight hair neatly drawn back. They are dressed in a flowing garment that covers their body and drapes down to their feet. The figure's right hand is behind them. The background is plain with no visible accessories or objects.

artworks.title: Etude
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image displays a full-body sketch of a person sitting in a seated posture, slightly hunched forward. The individual's right arm is bent, with their hand near their chin, and their left hand rests on the chair or surface they are seated on. The person's head is inclined forward, with a serene facial expression. Their hair is pulled back, and they are dressed in a long garment that covers their legs. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Etude pour un portrait
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a simple line drawing of a woman captured from head to toe in a standing position with her body slightly turned to the side. She has her left arm extended forward and is wearing a large, wide-brimmed hat that covers much of her head. She is dressed in a long, flowing coat or dress with wide sleeves that has a loose, draped appearance. The background is plain with no distinct elements, focusing attention on the woman. She is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects.

artworks.title: Etude pour un portrait
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on heavy laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seen from the back, displaying her full body. She is standing in a relaxed pose with one arm slightly extended to the side. Her face is not visible, and she has short hair mostly covered a large ornate hat with wide brims and decorative folds. The woman is wearing a long, flowing gown with puffed sleeves and a high collar, flowing elegantly down to her feet. Her hand is gesturing subtly, and the background is plain and unadorned with a light, neutral tone.

artworks.title: Le solitaire
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown-black on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman depicted from the waist up, sitting down and slightly leaning forward as she holds a small object in her hands. Her head is tilted downward. The woman has soft facial features, styled hair in an updo, and is wearing a long-sleeved gown with a high neckline. In the background, there are indistinct shapes that might represent furniture and a vase with flowers. The contrast between the woman's attire and the background creates a visual effect.

artworks.title: Le solitaire
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman shown from the waist up. She is positioned slightly turned to the left, with her head tilted downwards, concentrating on an object she is holding in her hands. Her facial features are depicted, and her hair is styled in an updo. The woman is dressed in a gown with long sleeves adorned with details. In her hands, she is holding a small item. The background is shaded with patterns and textures, suggesting an interior space with a floral arrangement in a vase visible above her on the right. The artwork is monochromatic, focusing on light and shadow to highlight the woman's demeanor.

artworks.title: Promenade
artworks.medium: woodcut in green-gray on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in silhouette. The drawing is minimal with a strong use of contrast between black lines and the white background. The central focus is on two stylized figures, one shorter, possibly depicting a child, wearing a hooded outfit. This figure stands next to a taller, more elongated figure, dressed in a long garment. The lines are simple yet expressive, capturing the essence of the forms and their relationship to each other, accentuated by their connected hands. The rest of the page remains mostly blank, drawing the viewer's attention toward the rectangular depiction of the two figures.

artworks.title: Promenade
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white minimalist illustration of two figures. One figure is tall, wearing a long dark robe and a tall hat, with abstract facial features. The other figure is shorter, dressed in a short hooded garment, facing towards the taller figure and reaching out an arm towards them. Both figures are depicted in profile within a rectangular border. The background is plain, with simple lines suggesting a doorway or room. The artwork is in black ink on beige paper.

artworks.title: Nymphes
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on green japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image displays two figures with their full bodies visible, standing closely together. The figure on the left is slightly turned with their back partially to the viewer, resting their head on the other figure's shoulder. The figure on the right is facing slightly forward and appears to be gesturing with an arm extended toward the upper right corner. Both figures have short to medium-length hair and are nude. There is vegetation to the right and below them, as well as a goat near their feet. The background is lightly rendered, suggesting foliage in the surroundings.

artworks.title: Fin de rêve
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract composition with human-like figures. The drawing depicts three figures intertwined in a dynamic arrangement. The central figure appears to be climbing or leaning over another figure, while a third figure in the background is seated or crouching. The image is rendered in black and white, with the figures sketched delicately yet expressively, emphasizing movement and interaction. The style suggests an exploration of form and emotion, conveyed through the use of shadow and line to create depth and intensity within the composition.

artworks.title: The Letter
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Herbert and Nannette Rothschild Memorial Fund in memory of Judith Rothschild
artworks.description: The image shows two women, a man, and a child standing in front of a plain background. The seated women have intricate hairstyles with curls and possible headpieces. The man standing has wavy hair tied back. One woman is holding an object and the other has her hands on her lap. The man has his hand near his mouth. The individuals are dressed in 18th-century clothing, with voluminous, ruffled garments and patterns. The child is also dressed in period attire and is holding onto a chair.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child Enthroned, Adored by Two Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown washes, heightened with white, over black chalk on tinted laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing featuring the upper bodies and heads of four main figures, as well as two cherubic figures in the upper left corner. The central figure is a seated woman with long hair in braids or soft styling, wearing flowing robes and holding a child standing on an elevated platform. The child appears youthful and playful. To the left and slightly below, a figure with a wreath on their head kneels, dressed in draped garb indicating motion. Opposite, another figure wearing a distinctive hat or headdress, possibly a bishop's mitre, gestures towards the child with a cloak draped around their shoulders. Several cherubs are shown among clouds in the upper left sky, contributing to the celestial atmosphere. The background includes architectural elements like large columns and an archway, suggesting a grand, indoor space, with clouds filling the upper left and merging into the ethereal scene.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child in Glory with Saint Theodore and a Monastic Saint
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lore Heinemann and Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in a dynamic scene. The drawing demonstrates swirling lines and fluid forms that suggest movement and interaction among the figures. Light and shadow are rendered through washes of ink, creating a sense of depth and volume. The characters appear to be gathered in a moment, possibly portraying a narrative or allegorical theme. The composition uses diagonal lines and curvilinear shapes, accentuating the central activity within the scene. The style of ink wash gives it a fluid feel, capturing a moment with simplicity.

artworks.title: Saint Ursula
artworks.medium: red chalk on beige oatmeal paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (irregular): 22 x 16.5 cm (8 11/16 x 6 1/2 in.)
mount: 25.9 x 19.5 cm (10 3/16 x 7 11/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with a three-quarter view from the waist up. The individual gazes slightly upwards, with long, wavy hair falling over their shoulders. They wear a flowing garment, likely a dress or robe, with textured fabric around the arms. One hand rests on the garment, while the other holds a slender cylindrical object against their chest. The background is plain with shading for depth.

artworks.title: Hexagonal Temple in an Italianate Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor and gray wash within a border drawn in blue watercolor and pen and black ink on laid paper extensively pricked for transfer
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective view of a grand neoclassical temple with a large, domed roof. The point of view is slightly elevated, offering a comprehensive look at the architecture and its surroundings. The horizon line separates the sky from distant architectural structures like ruins and smaller buildings on the left. The style appears to be architectural drawing with clear lines and minimal brushstrokes, emphasizing the temple's columns, friezes, and statues. The color palette is muted with beiges, whites, and light grays contrasting with faint blue and green hues in the landscape. People are seen moving around the base of the temple, with a spacious, serene feeling in the lightly sketched terrain beyond.

artworks.title: A Gentleman Standing with His Arms Crossed
artworks.medium: black chalk on 2 joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a man standing with his arms crossed in a side profile. He has prominent facial features, styled back hair with a bow at the back, and is dressed in 18th-century attire. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface with scattered speckles.

artworks.title: Skaters Outside a City Wall
artworks.medium: gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with a snowy landscape. Trees dominate the composition, with bare branches reaching up towards the sky. A tall structure resembling a tower or ruin is in the distance. Delicate brushstrokes capture the scene, emphasizing barren trees. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray. People are engaged in various activities on the ice-covered surface, including ice skating and tending to small fires. More figures can be seen walking in the distance.

artworks.title: Prospetto della Chiesa di S. Simeone Appostolo
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated point of view looking towards an elegant church structure in the center. The church has a dome, classical elements like a pediment with sculptures, and columns at the entrance. A secondary structure on the left has ornate detailing and a statue. Beyond the church, there are more architectural features like domes and an arched colonnade. The detailed lines create textures and shading, emphasizing the architectural precision and depth. The monochromatic palette uses gray tones to convey volume and antiquity. Figures near us add life to the setting and highlight the grandeur of the main structure.

artworks.title: Veduta del Prospetto della Chiesa del SS. Redentore
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a classical church, potentially the Chiesa del Santissimo Redentore. The front view displays a symmetrical facade with columns, statues, and a low horizon. The detailed engraving depicts fine lines illustrating the architecture, clouds, and stonework in shades of gray. Two figures row a boat near the church, while others are on the steps. In the background, a bell tower and other structures are visible, suggesting an urban setting.
